mapper.select: select ch.*, c.name as coupon_name, c.amount, c.min_point, c.use_type, c.platform, c.start_time, c.end_time, c.product_relation_json, c.product_category_relation_json from coupon_history ch inner join coupon c on c.id = ch.coupon_id where ch.id = #{id} and ch.member_username = #{username}
